messages.subject: Meet and Analyze Data, Wed Mar 04th 3-5 PM - CCAH Bennett Conference Room
messages.subject_clean: Meet and Analyze Data, Wed Mar 04th 3-5 PM - CCAH Bennett Conference Room
messages.body_plain:
Hello All,

This week we'll introduce Binder, an executable environment that makes
your code immediately reproducible by anyone, anywhere.

Hope to see you there!

*Time*: 3:00pm-5:00pm
*Location*: CCAH, Bennett Conference room
(http://campusmap.ucdavis.edu/?b=33).

*Description*

Meet and Analyze Data (MAD) is a community focused on tackling
biological big data questions ranging from high level concepts (/what is
metagenome assembly?/) to low level coding problems (/what does this
error message even mean!?/) and everything in between. Each week will
start with a short lesson to share important tools for project
management and data analysis designed to help us level up our skills.
Then, participants with expertise in a variety of areas will be
available to help with individual research and coding questions. To
facilitate this discussion, all questions must be posted on the MAD
discourse forum <https://mad.oxli.org/>. Help us help you: please try to
post your questions ahead of time, and be kind to our helpers as they
try to get to all the questions! To keep things fun for everyone, please
check out our Code of Conduct <http://ivory.idyll.org/lab/coc.html>.

*More info*

https://dib-training.readthedocs.io/en/pub/#meet-and-analyze-data-mad
**

Best,
The DIB-lettes

messages.subject: No D-RUG working group this week, schedule for the next three weeks
messages.subject_clean: No D-RUG working group this week, schedule for the next three weeks
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

We had originally planned to hold our last D-RUG session of the quarter tomorrow from 10-12pm. However, with the campus response to COVID-19, we thought it would be prudent to cancel our working group tomorrow. We will hold a "virtual" working group this week instead, where we will be monitoring the Discourse site (d-rug.discourse.group <http://d-rug.discourse.group>) for questions during our usual working group time.

We will also take a break from D-RUG sessions for finals week and Spring break. Currently, we have our working groups scheduled to meet at the same time and location for spring quarter: Thursdays, 10-12pm, 360 Shields library. However, we will announce our schedule for Spring quarter in a couple weeks, based on best information/recommendations from the campus.

waRmly,
Taylor & The D-RUG coordinators

messages.subject: D-RUG & COVID-19
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

Davis R Users Group will be taking a hiatus for the next two weeks due to COVID-19. We encourage you to use the discourse site to ask questions and interact with our community during this time (d-rug.discourse.group <http://d-rug.discourse.group>). We hope to offer remote options soon (tutorials/presentations etc.), but need a little time to plan what D-RUG will look like amidst campus closure and COVID-19. We will send along a schedule as soon as we have one!

youRs from a safe social distance,
D-RUG Coordinators
